VoiceMemo.title: VoiceMemo
VoiceMemo.description: A voice-transcribed memo saved by a senior user with server timestamps.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the memo owner.

content.description: Transcribed voice memo text (1 to 5000 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the memo was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the memo was last updated (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/memos/{memoId}.description: Private voice memos owned by the authenticated user.
